missionVision.title: Our Mission
missionVision.body: To make advanced technology genuinely useful for ordinary businesses — replacing repetitive work with systems that are reliable, measurable and understood by the people who depend on them.

missionVision.title: Our Vision
missionVision.body: A market where AI and automation are held to the same engineering standards as any other production system: tested, observable, documented and accountable for the outcomes they claim.

values.title: Clarity before code
values.body: We write the problem down and agree on it before estimating. Ambiguity is the most expensive thing in software.

values.title: Evidence over hype
values.body: Model and platform choices are made against evaluation cases, not marketing claims.

values.title: You own everything
values.body: Code, infrastructure and documentation are yours from day one. No lock-in, no hostage architecture.

values.title: Built to be maintained
values.body: The next engineer to open the codebase matters as much as the one who wrote it.

capabilities.title: Applied AI engineering
capabilities.description: Agent architectures, retrieval systems, structured extraction and evaluation harnesses that keep quality measurable over time.

capabilities.title: Process automation
capabilities.description: Orchestrated workflows with retries, idempotency, alerting and audit trails across the tools your business already runs on.

capabilities.title: Product engineering
capabilities.description: Full-stack web and mobile development, from data model and API design through to a maintained design system.

capabilities.title: Real-time voice systems
capabilities.description: Telephony integration, low-latency conversation handling, transcription and CRM write-back for inbound and outbound calling.

capabilities.title: Systems integration
capabilities.description: Resilient connections between CRMs, databases, payment platforms and third-party APIs, with drift detection built in.

capabilities.title: Infrastructure & delivery
capabilities.description: Containerised environments, CI pipelines, staged rollouts and the monitoring needed to operate a system confidently.
